Name: Edible Gels - Recipe and Product Pack
Author: failsplat
Description:
A content pack mod for Stardew Valley, containing a variety of edible gels and jellies. Adds several new crops and a forage item as raw materials, and gives you something edible to make out excess slime.
[size=5]Dependencies[/size]
All of these are needed for the mod to function:
- Artisan Valley
- Producer Framework Mod
- Farm Type Manager
- JsonAssets
[size=5]Optional Dependencies[/size]
These enable more recipes and items:
- PPJA Fruits and Veggies
- PPJA More Trees
- Bonster's Trees
- Bonster's Rare Crops
- Shaved Ice and Frozen Treats
- PPJA Fresh Meat

[size=5]Items Added
[/size]New items are listed in [b]BOLD[/b].
[*][b]Gelatin[/b] (made from Slime!)
[*][b]Fruit Gummies[/b]
[*][b]Fruit Gelatin[/b]
[*][b]Rainbow Jelly[/b]
[*][b]Blancmange[/b]
[*][b]Aspic[/b] and [b]Seafood Aspic [/b](Aspic requires Fresh Meat)
[*][b]Agar[/b] (made from [b]Red Algae[/b])
[*][b]Almond Jelly [/b](req. More Trees)
[*][b]Red Bean Yokan[/b] (req. PPJA Fruits and Veggies)
[*][b]Green Tea Yokan[/b]
[*][b]Coconut Pandan Jelly [/b](req. Bonster's Trees)
[*][b]Mango Coconut Jelly[/b]
[*][b]Arrowroot[/b] and [b]Arrowroot Noodles[/b]
[*][b]Aiyu Jelly[/b] (made from [b]Aiyu Fig Husks[/b])
[*][b]Aiyu Lemonade[/b] (req. More Trees)
[*][b]Grass Jelly[/b] (made from [b]Mesona[/b])
[*][b]Grass Jelly Shaved Ice[/b] (req. Shaved Ice)
[*][b]Konjac[/b] and [b]Konjac Noodles[/b]
[*][b]Nata de Coco[/b] and [b]Nata de Piña[/b]
[*][b]Special Tsua-Bing[/b] (req. Shaved Ice, Bonster's Rare Crops)
[/list][size=5][b]
Installation[/b][/size]
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Download this mod folder.
3. Put the unzipped content packs into `Stardew Valley/Mods` to install them.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
